_comment: The Wanderer's lost friend (content-zone-2-woodland.md §3.5 quest 1): find his friend in the kobold cave north-west of him and come back. The friend is the FallenTraveller remains in the cave's east chamber; reaching him means fighting through the den. Offered and turned in by the Wanderer (wanderer.json). Reward 311 XP on the turn-in row = the L9 half-level rule at the cave's L5 kobolds, 0.5 x 300 x 1.2^4. All values [PLACEHOLDER]; text plain.
title: The Lost Friend

stages.journal: The Wanderer's friend went into the kobold cave north-west of the Wanderer and did not come back. He wears a grey cloak and carries a walking staff.

objectives.tracker: Find the Wanderer's friend in the kobold cave

stages.journal: The Wanderer's friend lies dead at the back of the kobold cave.
Done. The Wanderer knows his friend is dead.
